indicator_name: Liquid assets to short-term liabilities, deposit takers (IMF FSI)
description: Ликвидные активы к краткосрочным обязательствам депозитных организаций (МВФ FSI)
methodology: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (dataflow IMF.STA/FSIC), core indicators for deposit takers, reported by the Kazakh authorities (NBK, then ARDFM), quarterly. Liquid assets to short-term liabilities, %, deposit takers, end of quarter.
